**Partly resolved from source** (D271; JourneyMap 5.2.23): it reads `journeymap\data\sp\<world>\waypoints\*.json` only when mapping starts (joining the world, every dimension change) or its Waypoint/Advanced options are saved; no file watcher, so a file written while the game runs shows after the next dimension change or rejoin. Still open: the Lab check (`docs/runbooks/ore_intel_check.md` B)

**Partly resolved** (PR #13; WO-0.8 tests, 2026-11-05): 8/8 live isolation tests pass as `gos-dev`; Claude Code and the toolchain run as `gos-dev`, and inheritance leaks no write access. Still open: `gos launch` starts Lab and Export

**Resolved from source** (D121; Prism 11.1.1): a pre-launch command that exits non-zero, crashes or can't start fails the launch before the game starts. The Lab check in `docs/runbooks/play_hooks.md` (step 3) confirms it on the PC

GregtecLink's server-side place/break listener sees GT machine placements with `mID` in single-player. **Passes in the listener harness** (D260, D262: 10 kinds placed and 4 broken by a fake player through Forge's events, ids from `mID`, registry name + meta); the Lab check (runbook `machine_events.md`) confirms it in the real pack
`safe_open()` lets 1.7.10's `level.dat` save-by-rename succeed while GOS reads. Soak-tested on a fake game on Linux and Windows CI (D257); the Lab save loop confirms it on the game
Tailscale Serve proxies the PC's tailnet name to `127.0.0.1:8765` over HTTPS, and works from the phone on cellular

A reliable "game paused" signal (log line or GregtecLink). Resolved from what the game writes (D258): the `Saving and pausing game...` line, unpaused by the server's next own line or autosave; the Lab test measures the line's delay

**Partly resolved from source** (D273, WO-6.7; CropsNH 2.0.140): weeds spread above each crop's own `weeds_above` (24 for most crops, 8 for Necrobloom; the quest's 23 is wrong) and only while Resistance is below Growth; an extra neighbour can block a parent-combination recipe (recipes match the first distinct breedable neighbours in registration order), so guides keep the other sides clear; two identical seeds can pool-mutate (pool matching counts duplicates) but never make a recipe (it needs two distinct parents); a Crop Manager tops sticks to 200 fertilizer once fertilizing is switched on in its GUI (it starts off); a stick uses 1 water and 1 fertilizer every growth tick, so the guide's times are the topped-up best case and it shows the dry nutrients. Still open: the Lab check of each (`docs/runbooks/crop_guide.md`) [I§2]

**Partly resolved from source** (D284, WO-7.6; CropsNH 2.0.140, GT 5.09.54.265, OC 1.12.68): a transposer shows a seed as `cropsnh:genericSeed`, damage 0, label `<crop name> Seeds` once analysed (`Unknown Seeds` before), so the station identifies seeds by label; stats are NOT readable (OC's `tag` is gzip, the data card inflates zlib), so it tracks them from the breeding maths; the Crop Breeder is a GT basic machine whose progress OC reads like the others (`hasWork`) and whose tank the transposer reads; automation takes items only from a GT machine's output (D282); the transposer is an MV Assembler recipe, the other parts are checked from the recipe DB by `gos crops station --parts` (partial: the part's own recipe, `MV unknown` for a recipe without a tier). Still open: the full parts answer from Clayton's export and the Lab check (`docs/runbooks/breeding_station.md`) [I§3, I§6]

**Partly resolved** (D273, WO-6.7): odds per tier (40% at LV, +10% a tier, 100% from ZPM) and the tanks match CropsNH's own tooltips in the harness export (tests/integration/test_crop_guide_harness.py); the LV/MV "high-stat" cap is the tank: one run's fertilizer (144 mB x child tier + 72 mB x stat points) has to fit 3,200 mB at LV and 6,400 mB at MV; catalysts come from the export's Crop Breeder recipes; Crop Breeder-only recipes are the export's `machine_only` ones. Still open: a run in the Lab at LV and MV (`docs/runbooks/crop_guide.md`) [I§2, I§6]

**Partly resolved** (D134, WO-1.10): in the dev runtime the client export runs all 11 CropsNH dumpers (crops, breeding recipes, mutation pools, soils and more) and every crop NEI's CropsNH tabs show is in the crop dump (131 crops; Crop Breeding 91 recipes, 104 crops). Still open: a full-pack Export run (`docs/runbooks/crops_check.md`) [I§2]

When a GT multiblock shuts down on its own (power loss, a maintenance problem), OC's `isWorkAllowed` reads false; if so, it reads as WO-7.4's `stopped` (D279), which WO-7.5's `machine_stalled` alert counts (`[alerts] stalled_stopped`, D280) and the advisor follows (D267, D281); the Lab test checks it does

GOS's processes (the core and the Discord bot, started windowless by the supervisor in Clayton's logon session, D116) read his real keyboard and mouse input through `GetLastInputInfo`, so D76's "away" (10 minutes without input) is right: `gos alerts routed` shows `away` false while he types and true after 10 idle minutes (D298)
